title: Storage Usage Cards

behavior.icon: Provider storage icon mapping with cloud fallback.
behavior.accessible_progress: Semantics exposes the usage summary while the visual progress bar is excluded from duplicate announcements.
behavior.quota_unknown_state: Unknown quota remains explicit and percentage is null.
behavior.freshness: Reading freshness is fresh, stale, or unknown based on measured timestamp.
behavior.error_state: Missing data renders an honest unavailable state without fabricated usage.
behavior.manage_action: Manage storage invokes the injected action and meets the 44px target.

boundary: Metadata-only local UI contract; no live provider, quota, credential, network, hosted CI, signing, telemetry, hardware, adoption, or publication claim.
